name: Every pause cut, each join a jump cut
what: Every silence of 0.16 s or more is cut down to 0.10 s at the join, measured on the envelope, written in whole frames into one file; each join stays a plain jump cut.
when: Every take; no flash or whoosh over a join.
why: Measured on the reference: the speaker never breathes on screen; cutting on the fly put the lips 2 frames behind the voice.
doc: SKILL.md § 2. Cut every pause: the jump cuts

name: Wide / close on every jump cut
what: The opening frame starts at 1.14 and settles to 1.0 in 0.6 s; every jump cut alternates wide 1.0 and close 1.08 on the cut; a section punches to 1.10; a change of scene goes wide and pushes in.
when: Always; the camera's punch is silent.
why: « j'aime beaucoup la motion, les animations ».

name: Low captions, three words, the said word in colour
what: Archivo ExtraBold captions low at y 0.765, three words at most, each on its onset, replaced never scrolled, the word being said in the accent colour.
when: The whole short; they step aside for a header, the hook's title or a paper phrase saying the same words.

name: Hook title in two faces
what: The reference's three lines: a white Archivo line, THE word of the promise in Fraunces in colour beside white words, a line on paper; the runs land one after the other from the first frame.
when: On the first sentence, gone on its last word.
why: « une combinaison de deux polices, un mot important en couleur, une très belle police ».

name: Key idea in two faces, no paper
what: The key idea of a sentence: a white word and the important one in Fraunces in colour, over the face or above the head, no paper.
when: On a sentence's key idea.

name: The v2 fonts and colours
what: The second version's three faces and colour set.
when: Never; Archivo, Fraunces and a marker hand replaced them.
why: « the fonts are not right, the colours are not right, it is not dynamic » (« absolument pas qualitatif »).
doc: scripts/example/README.md § The reviews, in the user's words

name: Yellow accent, tested on the take
what: THE important word and the caption word being said in yellow #FFD43B by default (or the brand's accent), checked on the take over hair, skin and walls.
when: Always.
why: Coral and orange vanished in the speaker's hair and face; the yellow read everywhere.

name: Coral or orange accent
what: The reference's coral, or orange, as the important word's colour.
when: Never by default.
why: They vanished in the speaker's hair and face.

name: Ruled notebook scraps
what: A collage of small flat white ruled notebook scraps, one per letter or two, hand-cut corners, crooked, overlapping, a 2 px soft shadow along every edge.
when: Every paper in the short (one paper everywhere).
why: « je préférerais les petits papiers de mon exemple de référence en eux-mêmes ».

name: Torn paper with fibre, crease and tape
what: The v3 torn collage pieces with fibre, a crease, tape, and light and shade across them.
when: Never.
why: « j'aime pas les petits papiers, comment ils rendent ».

name: Gradient on the paper
what: Shading or a gradient across a paper, a polaroid's border, or while a paper unfolds.
when: Never; the paper is flat.
why: « j'aime pas le dégradé sur le papier ».

name: Newsprint paper
what: Torn newsprint as a second paper.
when: Never, anywhere.
why: « c'est pas le bon papier, je l'aime pas du tout, fais attention à ne pas mettre ça ».

name: Flat paper labels without motion
what: The first version's flat paper labels with no paper effect or little animation.
when: Never.
why: « très mauvaise qualité »: no paper effect on the elements.
doc: scripts/example/README.md § The reviews, in the user's words

name: Paper only for titles and a few phrases
what: Paper only for the titles (the hook's paper line, sections, each numbered item, the ask) and two or three very important phrases.
when: Always.
why: « les sous-titres sont déjà en bas, donc on ne met pas l'effet papier à chaque mot ».

name: Paper on every keyword
what: A paper label above the head on every keyword said.
when: Never; stickers for lists said in passing, two faces for key ideas.
why: The captions already say the words; « l'effet papier n'est pas utilisé tout le temps ».

name: Gochi Hand marker hand on the paper
what: Every word on paper in a marker hand, Gochi Hand by default, letter-spaced so its « rn » never reads « m »; scaled to the same x-height.
when: Every word on paper.
why: « prends la police gochi hand », picked on a board of eight.

name: Paper tossed in, unfolding
what: A paper arrives from below and to the side, unfolding (scale y 0.25 to 1.06 to 1 in 4 frames) and settling a hair past, flat while it opens; it folds back up to leave.
when: Every paper.
why: The user's pick on the v2 boards (board B: it unfolds).

name: Every paper figure breathes
what: Once there, each paper and sticker alternates two poses, an edge moving a pixel or so.
when: On every paper and sticker.
doc: SKILL.md § What stays measured from the reference

name: Two shadows under everything
what: Every figure casts a contact shade and a soft shadow from its silhouette; while it flies in, its shadow falls further and softer, then tightens as it lands.
when: Always.
why: « aucune ombre derrière, niveau contraste, ça ne passe pas »; then « j'aime bien les ombres derrière ».

name: Motion blur
what: While a figure moves, 6 instants over half a frame are averaged (a 180 degree shutter).
when: Always (motionBlur false turns it off).

name: Arrivals and exits: slap, drop, swing, fold, flick, popout
what: A sticker slapped on in a damped bounce, a polaroid dropped from above, a section's name swinging in; exits fold, flick, pop out, swing out; a phrase lands and folds line by line.
when: Every figure, by its kind.

name: Red marker drawn as it is said
what: A red felt-tip strike, underline, circle, burst or curved arrow drawn on as the word is said; a white halo under it when drawn on the picture.
when: On the word it stresses; a strike when the speaker negates a word on paper.
why: Red on hair disappeared without the halo.

name: Die-cut emoji stickers round the head
what: An emoji or transparent picture about 0.15 W with a white die-cut border, a vinyl sheen and its label on one ruled scrap, slapped on round the head at x 0.13 / 0.87.
when: For what the hook implies, a list said in passing, the asides; one per word.
why: « j'aime bien les petits stickers avec les contours blancs ».

name: Pixel crew
what: Small pixel-art characters standing for roles or tools.
when: Never in a new plan; die-cut stickers replaced them.
why: Too small to read.
doc: scripts/example/README.md § The reviews, in the user's words

name: Real reaction GIFs as big polaroids
what: A real reaction GIF from GIPHY found by its meme's name, as a polaroid 0.80 of the width in the middle of the screen, always at the same place, tilted 3.2 degrees the other way each time, dropped on and flicked away.
when: On a feeling, a cost, a failure, an exaggeration or a comparison; four or five in a short, 1.5-2.6 s each.
why: « go, avec des vrais GIF »; then « plus gros, un peu plus bas dans l'écran, pour qu'on les voie bien ».

name: GIFs placed at random or small
what: Memes placed off the face, at random spots, at 0.60 of the width, without a nice entrance.
when: Never; one place, one size, one entrance.
why: « placés de manière beaucoup trop aléatoire, ils n'ont pas une belle animation d'entrée »; « un peu trop petits ».

name: Section header on scraps
what: The section's name on scraps swinging in from the side, its second line on smaller scraps, a number on a ruled tile slapped on first, a red underline drawn between, the camera punching in.
when: On a new section; each item of a list video is a section with its number.

name: Punch phrase on paper over the face
what: The punch of a paragraph on paper over the face, line by line, a word struck out in red if the speaker negates it.
when: Two or three in a short, not more.
doc: SKILL.md § 4. Read the transcript and decide the pictures

name: Real screens annotated in red
what: The real thing named on the face: a shot, a page on a phone, a ghosted screen, with red notes, a cursor and a scroll.
when: When the speaker names something that can be shown; a public page is captured, a private screen never invented.
doc: SKILL.md § What stays measured from the reference

name: Connect: two app icons and a marker arrow
what: Two icons as die-cut stickers slapped on one after the other, the marker's arrow from the second over to the first.
when: When two tools work together.

name: Waveform at the mouth
what: White bars at the mouth for a sound or a voice.
when: When a sound or a voice is named.
doc: SKILL.md § What stays measured from the reference

name: Paper sweep into a change of scene
what: A sheet of the same ruled paper swept across the whole frame right to left in 0.44 s, covering the cut, the captions off under it, the music dropping on it.
when: On a change of scene inside the take.

name: The ask on paper to the end
what: The call to action's keyword (« comment X ») on paper, held to the end.
when: At the end of the short.
doc: SKILL.md § 4. Read the transcript and decide the pictures

name: Generated illustrations
what: Nano Banana 2 pictures (clipart, infographic, halftone, cartoon) for what has no real picture, or a reaction panel when no GIF fits.
when: Only as an illustration or reaction; never a real product, logo, person or number.
why: Status not written in the docs.
doc: SKILL.md § 4. Read the transcript and decide the pictures

name: One move at a time
what: Two figures never share a zone at once; the one leaving is gone before the next lands; title above the head, stickers at the sides, polaroids and punch phrases on the face, captions low.
when: Always.
why: The user reads a collision as unpolished.

name: Hip Hop 02 bed 15 LU under the voice
what: A bed under the whole short, its momentary median 15 LU under the voice, Hip Hop 02 from 0 s by default, faded in over 0.25 s, gone in 0.12 s on a change of scene.
when: Every short unless the user asks for none.
why: « ça mériterait de mettre une musique de fond »; Hip Hop 02 picked on the music board and made the default.

name: No music
what: The reference's edit with no music anywhere.
when: Only when the user asks for none.
why: Taken back by the third review: « ça mériterait une musique de fond ».
doc: SKILL.md § What stays measured from the reference

name: Paper slide on every paper
what: A real Mixkit « Paper slide » recording when a paper lands, 19 LU under the voice; page turn, quick slice and scribble for sections, second lines and the marker.
when: On every paper; nothing on a paper folding away.
why: The user's pick on the boards; 19 kept as heard (« bien comme ça »).

name: Motionix light sounds
what: Pops for stickers and the coloured word, a shutter for a polaroid landing, swishes for flicks, a whoosh for a section, a riser into a change of scene, each at its measured level.
when: On what appears; a role repeated within 80 ms is one sound.
why: « des petits sons très légers ».

name: Synthesised sound kit
what: The first version's synthesised effects.
when: Never; real paper recordings and the packs replaced them.
why: « all the sound effects are bad: take what the other styles have, then the paper ».
doc: scripts/example/README.md § The reviews, in the user's words

name: Nothing heard on jump cuts or captions
what: No sound on the jump cuts, per caption word, on a paper folding away, or on a breath.
when: Always.

name: GIF credits
what: GIPHY GIFs carry their credit in the project's credits file, « GIFs via GIPHY » in the post; a paid ad never ships a meme.
when: Always.

name: Reproduce the validated look
what: The figures, sizes, places, faces, paper, motion, sounds and levels of the validated cut, on every take; a variation only when the user asks.
when: Always.
why: « OK, du coup, ce style de montage est validé » (v3.5).

name: Feed safe zones
what: Captions, polaroids, stickers, titles and labels stay inside x 0.095-0.905, y 0.128-0.774; the polaroid is narrowed and centred on x 0.4675.
when: Always.

name: Loudness at -14 LUFS
what: -14 LUFS, true peak -1.0 dBTP, two-pass loudnorm; every role measured as heard on the effects bus.
when: Always.
doc: plugins/video/references/audio-spec.md § Loudness: a standard, not a taste

name: Never regrade the footage
what: The tightened take keeps the source's bit depth and colour tags.
when: Always.

name: Pipecorn generic
what: About 6 s at the very end: Pipecorn, its values in one slot, Pipecorn again, no music; added on the delivered file.
when: A bonus asked every time, never on by default.

name: Your voice made better
what: ElevenLabs' voice isolator takes the room's echo and the noise out of the take before the edit.
when: A bonus asked every time, never on by default.
